### Executive summary


The Okta Customer Success Hub is a centralized management portal integrated into the Okta Support Center that gives IT administrators and security leaders real-time telemetry on deployment progress, an Identity Maturity Scorecard, phishing-resistant authenticator adoption tracking, and automated, contextual configuration playbooks.


For security leaders and admins, getting the most out of your identity technology requires continuous visibility, proactive security optimization, and rapid access to the right resources to execute effectively. Enter the new[Okta Customer Success Hub](https://support.okta.com/help/s/success-hub) —a centralized portal to track identity maturity progress, optimize configuration, and access tailored guidance on demand.


## What key metrics can admins track in the Okta Customer Success Hub?


Beyond access to regular snapshots, the[Customer Success Hub](https://support.okta.com/help/s/success-hub) brings your environment to life with continuous telemetry for real-time tracking at any point in your deployment:


- **Identity Maturity Scorecard:** Track your organization’s stage-by-stage progress across the[Okta Identity Maturity Model](https://www.okta.com/resources/whitepapers/okta-identity-maturity-model/) with a clear breakdown of completed milestones and remaining posture gaps.
- **Phishing-resistant authenticator trends:** Monitor usage trends across your[authenticators](https://learning.okta.com/path/implement-passwordless-authentication) , such as Okta FastPass and FIDO WebAuthn, to help strengthen your workforce’s resilience against[phishing attacks](https://learning.okta.com/path/evaluate-the-business-impact-of-phishing-resistance) .
- **License and feature utilization:** Gain round-the-clock visibility into active usage metrics across your Okta suite, including[Lifecycle Management, Workflows](https://learning.okta.com/path/automate-user-lifecycle-management-with-workflows) , and threat detection data.


## How does the Customer Success Hub guide identity maturity and configuration?


Every organization’s security goals are unique, and your guidance should match your current state. The[Customer Success Hub](https://support.okta.com/help/s/success-hub) replaces generic documentation with a contextual engine tailored to your environment:


- **Personalized security roadmaps:** The Success Hub analyzes your live telemetry and business objectives to highlight your **next best action** —whether you are optimizing advanced[Okta Workflows](https://www.okta.com/products/workflows/) or just beginning your automation journey.
- **Interactive goal tracker and[Identity Maturity Checklist](https://support.okta.com/help/s/article/okta-s-identity-maturity-checklist?language=en_US) :** Co-manage your deployment milestones right inside the Success Hub. Create to-do items, set target dates, assign team owners, and check off recommended security best practices as your deployment evolves.


## How do security teams access Okta support, training, and expertise?


Whether you prefer self-guided learning or tailored assistance, the Success Hub provides a centralized path to resources right when you need them:


- **Intelligent self-service:** Find relevant documentation and best-practice guides curated specifically for your active product stack.
- **Tailored learning and events:** Explore relevant[Okta Learning](https://learning.okta.com/) courses, earn skill badges to validate expertise, and browse upcoming webinars directly from your dashboard.
- **Direct account team visibility:** Easily view your account team details right on the Home tab.[Gold Premier Success Plan](https://www.okta.com/blog/industry-insights/okta-gold-plan-tei-roi/) customers can also unlock direct access to specialized experts for personalized business and technical guidance at any stage.


## Put your identity insights to work


The[Customer Success Hub](https://support.okta.com/help/s/success-hub) bridges the gap between executive strategy and hands-on execution—it delivers the high-level clarity needed for strategic alignment alongside the day-to-day tools required to continuously strengthen your identity posture.


### Explore your Customer Success Hub today


The Customer Success Hub is now live for all[Okta Workforce Identity](https://www.okta.com/products/workforce-identity/) customers, offering a centralized experience tailored to your organization’s identity journey.


To access your dashboard:


1. Log in to the[Okta Support Center](https://support.okta.com/help/s/?language=en_US)
2. Select **Resources** in the primary navigation
3. Click[Customer Success Hub](https://support.okta.com/help/s/success-hub) to launch your personalized dashboard
